content: Take this medication exactly as prescribed by your doctor to minimize the risk of addiction. Side Effects: Common side effects may include constipation, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, or drowsiness. If any of these effects persist or worsen, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately. Remember, this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits to you outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. If you are in the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Precautions: Before taking eluxadoline, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. This medication may cause drowsiness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities that require alertness until you are sure you can perform them safely. Limit alcoholic beverages, and discuss marijuana use with your doctor. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is not known whether eluxadoline passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk for serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Notes: Do not share this medication with others. Laboratory tests (such as liver function tests and lipase levels) may be conducted while you are taking this medication to monitor your progress and check for side effects. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose. Take your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Keep this medication in a secure place to prevent theft, misuse, or abuse. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This summary does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
